specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Rockchip RK3576J, Quad-core Cortex-A72 (1.6GHz) + Quad-core Cortex-A53 (1.4GHz)

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: Internal M.2 NVMe connector for SSD (optional), MicroSD Card

specs.name: Display
specs.value: 10.1” IPS LCD, 1280 x 800 px, brightness 400 cd/m2

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 1 x USB 3.0 type-A Host, 1 x USB 2.0 type-A Host, 1 x USB type-C OTG (USB-C can’t be used together with USB-A 3.0 port)

specs.name: LAN
specs.value: 1 x Giga LAN (no support for PoE)

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: 3.5mm Audio In/Out Connector, 2W Speaker Internal, Internal Front Microphone

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: Relay
specs.value: 1 x relay with “Normally Connected” and “Normally Open” output

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default 1 x RS485; up to 2 x RS485 (optional)

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: Default 0 x CAN; Optional 1 x CAN FD BUS. Arbitration Bit Rate up to 1Mbps, Data Bit Rate up to 8Mbps

specs.name: 3G/4G/LTE/GPS
specs.value: Internal 4G/LTE module supported, not mounted by default
